title: Analog Output
text: Output data to multiple analog channels of data acquisition device, 1 input, {Number of ports} sets Number of input data ports 1 for all channels; {Device}, {Channels} sets the device channel selection and configuration options depend and {Output sample rate} sets the device sampling rate. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Device
params.values: Device through which you want to output data select available device

params.name: Channels
params.values: Device channel selection and configuration options depend on device

params.name: Number of ports
params.values: Number of input data ports 1 for all channels | 1 per channel
